title: SDK onboarding scaffolds: opinionated Next.js / FastAPI / Go HTTP / CLI cookbook
creator: Priya Nair
description:
Deliver a small set of opinionated, production-minded starter scaffolds and cookbook snippets that demonstrate: 
- Multi-language SDK usage patterns (TypeScript/Next.js, Python/FastAPI, Go HTTP server, and a cross-platform CLI)
- Robust retry and backoff strategies for transient errors (429/503) that integrate with our client SDKs
- Streaming ergonomics: server-side streaming with incremental UI updates (Next.js), server-sent events and async generators (FastAPI and Go), and CLI progress handling
- Best-practice config for batching, KV cache hints, and safe timeouts to meet latency/cost tradeoffs

Acceptance criteria:
1) Four repo templates (Next.js, FastAPI, Go HTTP, CLI) each with README, quickstart, and 3 runnable examples: simple generation, streaming chat, and retry logic with exponential backoff and jitter.
2) Short cookbook.md containing 8 copy-paste snippets (TS, Py, Go) for retries, streaming, graceful shutdown, and pagination-aware batching.
3) CI smoke test that runs examples against a local mock server (github action).
4) A single RFC-style doc that calls out ergonomics decisions and recommended default client settings.
5) Linked GH PR(s) and review approvals from SDK lead and Developer Experience PM.
